description: Property edits beside unknown properties, one per step: the user property T.CalcDbUnknown given a new value of the same length; then a longer value; then the field property T.A Description changed; then the database property CalcDbProp given a longer value. Asks a same-length patch versus a length-changing rewrite, and what happens to the other properties' values and positions. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it. The full catalog view is taken before the steps and after them (each a read-only open, with its own file state).
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
